{{Quote|The Immalians had a small outpost there to protect their mining operations from pirate attacks.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], on Mayvitch 7|<ref name="AoW1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Immalians''' were natives of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] world [[Immalia]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> They maintained a mining colony on [[Mayvitch 7]], which was [[Battle of Mayvitch 7|wiped out]] by the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="AoW1" />
